items.title: Government Targets D37.4 Billion in 2027 Revenue, Banking on VAT, Excise and Customs
items.summary: By Staff Writer The Gambia government is targeting D37.39 billion in government revenue in 2027, a 16.1 percent increase from the D32.20 billion approved for 2026, with the government relying heavily on customs duties, value-added tax, and excise taxes to drive the increase. T...
